item.title: 05-01 Protest Environment. Social Sabotage
item.description: This work examines the transition from resistance to deliberate non-participation. When society stops fueling the mechanisms of dictatorship, power loses its functionality. The work explores silence, pause, and collective inaction as instruments of civilizational transition.
